author: Claude
method: Decided from the Phase 1 evidence (DETECT pictures, section maps, cue lists, hints) plus the rules Sam's own edits taught earlier today. Written before this arrangement was built; scored afterwards against Sam's SW Tweaks with learn_from_correction.py.
rules: R1 Swap on the incoming's first drop, or on its bass-in phrase point when the drop is far in, against a real cue on the outgoing (outro start, kick dropout, last drop end); snap to the outgoing's 8-bar grid when the detected boundary is an odd-bar section.
R2 The incoming enters late: 8-16 of its own intro bars before the swap; the whole intro when the outgoing can run out under it. Never trim an intro to force a drop onto a landmark.
R3 Blend 16-34 bars; up to about 50 only when the outgoing's own last bars loop cleanly under the incoming's intro and first drop.
R4 After the swap the outgoing gets 12-18 bars, then out. Loop its own last 1-2 bars if it ends cold; cut its outro down if it is long; never build the tail from other material.
R5 A fill on the outgoing finishes before the swap.

R6 If the outgoing's last drop ends before the incoming's drop, a crossfade, not an EQ kill (automation only; not expressible here, so the swap is put at the incoming's mid-intro phrase point on the outgoing's natural end).

transitions.out_track: Demarkus Le- A Deep-Felt Love (Ralph Session Extended Remix) 24 Bit MASTER AMENDED
transitions.in_track: Sam Leagas - Bad Behaviours (Extended Mix) SW V2
transitions.reason: Sam Leagas's drop_1 on Demarkus's outro start. Sam Leagas's drop_1 is 16 bars then a 16-bar build; Demarkus's 18-bar outro would end 2 bars into that build, ragged. Its own first 2 outro bars loop x7 (quality 0.63, clean) so it runs under the build and leaves exactly on drop_2 (bar 48): the R3 exception, the outgoing's own last bars under the incoming's intro and first drop, 48-bar blend. The alternative, cutting the outro to end on the build, was rejected because the build would run solo. R1, R3.

transitions.out_track: Sam Leagas - Bad Behaviours (Extended Mix) SW V2
transitions.in_track: HNTR - Short Stop (Extended Mix) SW V3
transitions.out_cue: bar 136, 8-bar grid (detected outro 135 is a 7-bar section)
transitions.reason: HNTR's intro is 8 bars. Sam Leagas's detected outro at 135 sits on an odd 7-bar drop_4 (BAR-MATH flag); the swap goes on the grid line 136. 16 bars of Sam Leagas after the swap, no loop. R1, R4.

transitions.out_track: HNTR - Short Stop (Extended Mix) SW V3
transitions.reason: Zaro's first 4 bars carry loud one-off hits in the other stem (DETECT), so it enters at its bar 4 on HNTR's build_2 grid line 136; its drop_1 lands on HNTR's outro start. HNTR's 8-bar outro plus 4 bars x2 gives 16 after the swap. 48-bar blend, allowed by R3 because the loop is HNTR's own outro. R1, R3, R4.

transitions.out_cue: natural end bar 132, then the looped tail
transitions.reason: Zaro has no outro and ends cold at 132; Pat Premier's whole 32-bar intro plays from Zaro's kick dropout at 116 (R2). Zaro's last 2 bars loop 3.5 times so it runs out 9 bars before Pat Premier's drop (R4, R6). The swap sits at Zaro's natural end on Pat Premier's bar 16; the looped bars play bass-cut, which is the fade.

transitions.in_track: Tommy Farrow - Falling (New Audio 27.07.26 Extended MIx) 24 Bit MASTER
transitions.reason: Tommy Farrow's bar-31 dropout on Pat Premier's outro start, the anchor Sam kept. Tommy Farrow's 44-bar intro is the one intro cut here: its first 16 bars go so it enters on Pat Premier's last drop (bar 64) with 15 bars of intro before the swap (R2). Pat Premier's 5-bar outro plays out; every loop candidate on it fails the quality gate, so no loop.

transitions.out_track: Tommy Farrow - Falling (New Audio 27.07.26 Extended MIx) 24 Bit MASTER
transitions.in_track: Arielle Free, Idris Elba - Cause I Can SW V1
transitions.reason: Arielle's drop_1 on Tommy Farrow's drop_3 end. Tommy Farrow's own 16-bar outro is the tail (R4), so no loop: the pipeline's 64-bar blend came from looping his intro drums, which R4 forbids. 32-bar blend.

transitions.out_track: Arielle Free, Idris Elba - Cause I Can SW V1
transitions.in_track: Coldabank -Never Say Sorry (Extended Mix) SW V3 AMENDED
transitions.reason: Arielle's outro is 7 bars and Coldabank's drop is 32 bars in, so the swap goes on Coldabank's bass-in phrase against Arielle's outro start (R1 fallback), whole intro (R2), Arielle runs out 7 bars later (R4; her loop candidates fail quality). Bass-in reads as bar 8 on the DETECT; the swap is on bar 9 so the blend clears the 16-bar minimum.

transitions.out_track: Coldabank -Never Say Sorry (Extended Mix) SW V3 AMENDED
transitions.in_track: Switch Disco - You Are All I Need (Extended Mix) SW V2 24 Bit MASTER
transitions.reason: Switch Disco's drop_1 on Coldabank's kick dropout at 88. Coldabank ends cold 10 bars later; its last bar loops x6 (quality 0.64) so it ends exactly on Switch Disco's break_1 start (bar 32), 16 after the swap. R1, R4.

transitions.out_track: Switch Disco - You Are All I Need (Extended Mix) SW V2 24 Bit MASTER
transitions.in_track: RUZE & Chesster - Another Night (Ranger Trucco Extended Remix) 24 Bit MASTER
transitions.reason: RUZE's drop_1 lands after Switch Disco's 4-bar fill_2, not on it (R5). RUZE's drop_1 is 16 bars then a 32-bar break, so Switch Disco should be gone soon after: its last drop loses its first 10 bars at the swap and plays its last 10 plus the 8-bar outro, 18 after the swap (R4), ending 2 bars into RUZE's break. No loop.

transitions.out_track: RUZE & Chesster - Another Night (Ranger Trucco Extended Remix) 24 Bit MASTER
transitions.in_track: Yellody feat Lovelee - No Time To Stop (Extended Mix) SW V5
transitions.reason: Yellody's drop_1 on RUZE's dropout at 192. Yellody's drop_1 is 12 bars then a break; RUZE's 18-bar outro would run 5 bars into that break, so 4 bars come out of its middle and it keeps its last 5, ending 1 bar into the break, 13 after the swap (R4).

transitions.out_track: Yellody feat Lovelee - No Time To Stop (Extended Mix) SW V5
transitions.in_track: Cevin Fisher - Give Me My Pleasure (Main Mix) 24 Bit MASTER
transitions.reason: Cevin Fisher's drop_1 on Yellody's outro start; Yellody's 15-bar outro is the tail (R4). 31-bar blend, no loop.
